content.about: Ukraine is the largest country entirely in Europe, with rich black farmland, the Carpathian Mountains and a coast on the Black Sea. It is one of the world's biggest grain producers. Kyiv has golden-domed churches more than a thousand years old. Painted Easter eggs called pysanky are a Ukrainian tradition.

standout.text: The Arsenalna station in Kyiv is one of the deepest metro stations in the world.

didYouKnow: Ukraine is one of the world's largest sunflower oil producers.
Borscht, a beetroot soup, is a national dish.
The Antonov An-225 was built in Ukraine.
